metadata.name: Navo
metadata.description: Independent, unofficial Telegram client for Android, Windows, and macOS. Sign in with your existing Telegram account — built with Flutter on TDLib.

summary.zh: Navo是基于Flutter与TDLib开发的独立非官方Telegram第三方客户端，支持Android、iOS、Windows、macOS四大平台，用户可使用现有Telegram账号登录，实现多端一致的即时通讯体验，各平台均已开放下载或测试通道。
summary.en: Navo is an independent unofficial Telegram third-party client built with Flutter and TDLib, supporting Android, iOS, Windows and macOS. Users can log in with their existing Telegram accounts for a consistent cross-platform instant messaging experience, with all platforms offering download or public beta access.

metadata.name: Open-Box
metadata.description: OpenWrt 一体化透明代理方案:一条命令装完 sing-box 内核 + 管理面板,浏览器打开即用

summary.zh: Open-Box是面向OpenWrt及Debian/Ubuntu系统的一体化透明代理方案，内置sing-box内核与可视化Web管理面板，一条命令即可完成全组件部署，无需手写配置，支持多协议节点管理、智能分流、DNS接管及不重启内核切换规则，适用于路由器主/旁路由及主机的网络代理与流量管控场景。
summary.en: Open-Box is an all-in-one transparent proxy solution for OpenWrt and Debian/Ubuntu systems, integrating the sing-box kernel and a visual web management panel. It supports full deployment with a single command without manual configuration, and provides features like multi-protocol node management, intelligent traffic routing, DNS takeover, and rule switching without kernel restart, suitable for network proxy and traffic control scenarios of main/bypass routers and host devices.

summary.zh: 基于Flutter开发的跨平台影视播放客户端，覆盖Android TV、手机、Windows、Linux等多端，针对大屏设备优化遥控交互，支持直播回放、多服务器自动切换、IPv6优先解析等功能，本地缓存体验优于网页版。
summary.en: A Flutter-based cross-platform video streaming client for Android TV, mobile, Windows and Linux. Optimized for large-screen devices with remote-friendly interaction, it supports live TV replay, automatic server switching, IPv6 priority resolution, and delivers smoother local caching experience than the web version.

metadata.name: edgeever

summary.:: zh": "EdgeEver是开源AI原生知识库与印象笔记替代方案，原生支持MCP协议，支持Cloudflare零成本或Docker部署，保留经典三栏布局，全栈开源，集成AI Agent，轻量化适配万级笔记，支持多端同步，满足个人知识管理与高效笔记场景需求。",

summary.:: 本仓库将张雪峰高考志愿、考研、职业规划的实战思维框架蒸馏为可运行的AI Agent Skill，基于多源权威调研提炼核心心智模型与决策启发式，适配多主流AI开发运行时，可复现其就业导向的务实决策逻辑，为用户提供升学、职业规划的智能决策辅助。
summary.en: This repository distills Zhang Xuefeng's practical thinking framework for college entrance exam application, postgraduate exam, and career planning into a runnable AI Agent Skill. Based on multi-source authoritative research, it extracts core mental models and decision heuristics, supports multiple mainstream AI development runtimes, and replicates his employment-oriented pragmatic decision logic to provide intelligent decision assistance for users' education and career planning.

summary.en: Clash Verge Rev is the official continuation of the original Clash Verge project, a cross-platform Clash Meta proxy client built on the Tauri framework, supporting Windows, macOS and Linux. It integrates the Clash Meta core, offering proxy configuration management, TUN mode, visual rule editing, WebDav backup sync and other features, with a customizable and user-friendly interface.

summary.en: GitPush is an AI-powered GitHub Release Tracker built on Cloudflare's serverless ecosystem, requiring no self-deployment to monitor version updates of specified repositories. It leverages Workers AI to generate intelligent update summaries and delivers them via email automatically, supporting web interface, API and scheduled triggers, ideal for developers tracking iterations of open-source projects or dependencies.

It supports an addon ecosystem for aggregated video content, cross-device sync, casting, multi-language support and PWA installation, delivering a one-stop streaming entertainment solution for users.

It automatically updates quota, model and price information of each site, offers one-click configuration scripts, cross-site comparison and availability history queries, and supports user submissions to add new sites, lowering the threshold for using AI coding tools.

summary.en: LinkSwift is a JavaScript-based browser extension that extracts direct download links for files from 8 mainstream cloud storage platforms including Baidu Netdisk and Alibaba Cloud Disk, bypassing client restrictions and download speed limits, and can unlock additional cloud storage benefits when paired with supporting membership scripts.

It has no ad/analytics SDKs or data collection, and integrates core features like ad blocking, local encrypted password vault, userscripts and offline reading, with excellent privacy and performance.

metadata.name: FluxDown

summary.zh: FluxDown是基于Rust开发的开源多协议下载管理器，支持HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent、HLS/DASH等主流协议，具备智能多线程加速、浏览器无缝集成、MCP服务能力，覆盖Windows/macOS/Linux/Android等多平台，永久免费无广告，是IDM的高性能开源替代方案。
summary.en: FluxDown is a Rust-powered open-source multi-protocol download manager that supports mainstream protocols such as HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent, HLS and DASH. It offers intelligent multi-threaded acceleration, seamless browser integration, and a built-in MCP server, running on Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. As a free, ad-free, high-performance alternative to IDM, it delivers exceptional download experience.

summary.en: Fapiao Print is a lightweight desktop tool designed for batch electronic invoice processing, built on Tauri 2.x. It supports importing multiple formats including PDF, OFD, XML and images, offering intelligent recognition, custom layout, batch printing, renaming and summary export. An OCR-enabled version is available, suitable for financial reimbursement scenarios, and runs as a single portable exe file.

It supports search and playback, playlist import from mainstream platforms, automatic source switching with fallback, PWA and Android installation (only 2.5MB), plus data backup and sync, meeting cross-platform music listening needs.

summary.en: OmniRoute is a free, MIT-licensed AI gateway that unifies 359 AI providers (150+ with free tiers) and 1200+ models including Kimi, Claude, GPT via a single endpoint. It is compatible with mainstream AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor, features quota-aware auto-fallback and RTK+Caveman compression that cuts token usage by 15-95%, and supports MCP/A2A protocols plus desktop/PWA forms, enabling zero-cost multi-model AI access for developers.

It requires no browsers, Docker or external CDNs, providing multi-tab remote terminals, SFTP file management, online code editing and AI-assisted operations, with all credentials encrypted and stored locally, ideal for server operations in personal and trusted intranet environments.

It supports offline voice wake-up, full-duplex real-time interaction, and bidirectional MCP control for both device-side and cloud-side. Compatible with 138+ ESP32 development boards, it applies to scenarios like smart home and personal AI assistant, supporting 39 languages and customizable resources.

It offers desktop GUI, CLI, Web UI and Docker deployment, suitable for efficient media deduplication for personal and NAS use cases.

metadata.name: trackerslist
metadata.description: Updated list of public BitTorrent trackers

summary.zh: 本仓库维护每日自动更新的公开BitTorrent Tracker列表，提供按UDP/HTTP/HTTPS/I2P等协议分类、IP直连版本的Tracker清单，已自动去重并过滤失效节点，搭配多镜像源分发，用于提升BT下载的连接成功率与下载速度。
summary.en: This repository hosts a daily auto-updated list of public BitTorrent trackers, providing categorized lists by protocols including UDP/HTTP/HTTPS/I2P and IP-direct connection versions, with automatic deduplication and invalid node filtering, plus multiple mirror sources for distribution, to improve the success rate and speed of torrent downloads.

summary.zh: 基于Cloudflare Workers/Pages的边缘代理订阅管理工具，支持VLESS、Trojan、xhttp多协议，内置优选IP管理、延迟测试、多客户端订阅自动转换，图形化KV配置实时生效无需重复部署，适配Clash、Sing-box等主流代理客户端，解决代理节点订阅与优选IP动态分发的痛点。
summary.en: A Cloudflare Workers/Pages-based edge proxy subscription management tool supporting VLESS, Trojan and xhttp protocols, with built-in optimal IP management, latency testing and automatic multi-client subscription conversion. It features graphical KV configuration that takes effect in real time without redeployment, compatible with mainstream proxy clients like Clash and Sing-box, solving pain points of proxy node subscription and dynamic optimal IP distribution.

metadata.name: renewhelper
metadata.description: RenewHelper - 时序·守望是一款基于Cloudflare Workers的全栈服务生命周期提醒、管理工具。它专为管理周期性订阅、域名续费、服务器到期等场景设计。无需服务器，零成本托管，提供精美的机甲风（Mecha-style）UI 界面、强大的农历/公历计算核心、多渠道通知推送能力、iCal日程同步以及账单管理功能。同时支持Worker和Docker方式部署。

summary.zh: RenewHelper（时序·守望）是基于Cloudflare Workers的全栈服务生命周期管理工具，专为周期性订阅、域名/服务器续费提醒等场景设计，无需自有服务器即可零成本托管，支持农历/公历周期计算、多渠道通知、iCal同步及账单管理，提供机甲风UI，支持Worker与Docker双部署。
summary.en: RenewHelper (Chronos Watch) is a full-stack service lifecycle management tool built on Cloudflare Workers, designed for scenarios such as periodic subscription, domain and server renewal reminders. It requires no self-owned servers for zero-cost hosting, supports lunar/solar cycle calculation, multi-channel notifications, iCal sync and billing management, features a Mecha-style UI, and supports dual deployment via Workers or Docker.

metadata.name: whistle
metadata.description: HTTP, HTTP2, HTTPS, Websocket debugging proxy

summary.:: Whistle是基于Node.js的跨平台网络抓包调试代理，支持HTTP、HTTPS、HTTP/2、WebSocket、TCP等多协议的抓包与请求响应修改，内置Weinre、Composer等调试工具，支持规则配置与插件扩展，适用于前后端开发调试、接口测试等场景，覆盖桌面及无界面服务器环境。
summary.en: Whistle is a Node.js-based cross-platform network packet capture and debugging proxy that supports capturing and modifying requests and responses for protocols including HTTP, HTTPS, HTTP/2, WebSocket and TCP. It offers built-in debugging tools such as Weinre and Composer, supports rule-based configuration and plugin extension, and is suitable for front-end/back-end development debugging and API testing, with support for both desktop and headless server environments.

metadata.name: bilibili-video-downloader
metadata.description: 哔哩哔哩 bilibili B站 视频 下载器，图形界面 + nfo刮削 + 广告标记 + 字幕下载 + 弹幕下载，轻松将视频加入emby等媒体库

summary.:: 这是一款基于Tauri v2开发的跨平台B站视频下载桌面工具，支持普通视频、番剧、课程等全类型内容下载，具备图形界面、NFO刮削、字幕/弹幕下载、广告标记等能力，可无缝对接Emby等媒体库，轻量易用。
summary.en: This is a cross-platform Bilibili video downloader desktop tool built with Tauri v2, supporting downloads of all content types including regular videos, anime series and courses. It provides a GUI, NFO scraping, subtitle/danmaku download, ad marking, and can be integrated with media libraries like Emby, featuring lightweight and user-friendly design.

metadata.description: go-rename 照片视频重命名工具 支持Windows/MacOS/Linux等各平台

summary.zh: go-rename 是基于 Golang 开发的跨平台照片视频重命名工具，支持 Windows/MacOS/Linux 多系统及 x86/arm 等多架构运行。可依据 EXIF 拍摄时间、文件创建/修改时间或 MD5 值对媒体文件重命名，自动处理同名冲突，解决不同设备拍摄文件重名、整理不便的痛点，适用于个人媒体库整理场景。
summary.en: go-rename is a Golang-based cross-platform photo and video renaming tool supporting Windows, MacOS, Linux across x86/arm architectures. It renames media files based on EXIF shooting time, file creation/modification time or MD5 value, automatically resolves filename conflicts, solves the pain points of duplicate filenames and disorganized media from different devices, and is suitable for personal media library organization.

summary.en: This repository is an aggregated list of projects by Chinese independent developers, collecting ready-to-use websites and apps across fields such as AI tools, productivity applications, and content creation. Projects are categorized by development status, and developers can contribute their works via PR. It serves as a community resource for showcasing indie dev outputs and finding inspiration.

summary.en: This project offers a free proxy pool updated and validated every 5 minutes, supporting HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS4/SOCKS5 protocols across 133 countries. It provides multi-format downloads (TXT/JSON/CSV) and a rotating proxy API with no duplicate proxies, suitable for web scraping, cross-border access, service testing and other scenarios.

summary.en: GitHubDaily is the official open-source project aggregation and information sharing platform for developers. Founded in 2015, it has shared over 10,000 high-quality GitHub open-source projects covering categories such as AI tools, development tools and learning tutorials. Through multi-platform distribution and annual categorized reviews, it helps developers discover excellent projects, keep up with tech trends and improve programming skills.

summary.en: This open-source repository aggregates PDF textbooks for all Chinese education stages including primary, junior high, senior high and university. It aims to break the paywall of educational resources, promote education equity, and provide overseas Chinese children with access to domestic basic education materials, covering multi-subject and multi-version textbooks for free.

metadata.name: ai-goofish-monitor
metadata.description: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。

summary.zh: 基于Playwright与AI的闲鱼智能监控系统，提供Web可视化管理后台，支持多任务实时/定时监控、自然语言生成筛选规则、多维度商品过滤、多渠道即时通知，助力用户从海量闲鱼商品中快速定位心仪产品，支持Docker一键容器化部署。
summary.en: An AI-powered Idle Fish (Xianyu) commodity monitoring system built on Playwright, equipped with a web-based visual management console. It supports multi-task real-time/scheduled monitoring, natural language-driven filter rule generation, multi-dimensional product filtering, and multi-channel instant notifications, helping users quickly find desired items from massive Idle Fish listings, with one-click Docker containerized deployment support.

metadata.name: OpenList

metadata.name: SaveAny-Bot
metadata.description: Save Any Telegram File to Anywhere 📂 (Alist, Disk, Webdav, S3, Rclone...) . Support restrict saving content and files beyond telegram.

summary.zh: SaveAny-Bot 是一款 Telegram 自动化文件归档工具，可突破平台禁止保存限制，支持文档、视频、 sticker 等全类型文件及 Telegraph 内容的批量/流式传输，可对接 Alist、S3、WebDAV 等 10+ 存储后端，集成 yt-dlp、Aria2 实现跨站资源下载，支持自定义 JS 插件扩展，适用于 TG 资源归档、跨存储迁移场景。
summary.en: SaveAny-Bot is a Telegram automated file archiving bot that bypasses platform content saving restrictions, supports batch/streaming transfer of all file types including documents, videos, stickers and Telegraph content, integrates with 10+ storage backends like Alist, S3 and WebDAV, supports yt-dlp and Aria2 for cross-site resource downloading, and allows custom JS plugin extension, suitable for Telegram resource archiving and cross-storage migration.

metadata.name: Deadpool

summary.summary: Deadpool是基于Go开发的代理池工具，支持从Hunter、Quake、FOFA等网络空间测绘平台采集高质量SOCKS5代理，也可本地导入，内置代理健康检测、轮询转发、优雅关闭等能力，主要面向合法授权的安全测试场景，解决测试IP被封、高可用代理获取难的问题。

summary.en: LX Music Mobile is an open-source music aggregation player built with React Native, integrating official music sources from multiple platforms. It supports local playlist management and self-hosted multi-device data sync, uses Redux for state management, only supports Android 5+, and is open-sourced under the Apache 2.0 license.

summary.en: Breezy Weather is a free and open-source Android weather app built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, featuring Material 3 Expressive design. It supports over 50 weather data sources, offering functions including weather forecast, real-time observation, air quality, pollen index, and disaster alerts, with excellent visualization effects, and supports distribution via GitHub, F-Droid and other channels.

summary.en: This is an open-source localization tool for GitHub Desktop client, developed with C++. It automatically replaces English text in the app with Chinese via regex matching, featuring high version compatibility, automatic mapping file updates, and exception rollback. Only mapping file updates are required to adapt to new versions, with low maintenance cost, enabling one-click client localization.

summary.en: Notepad-- is a lightweight cross-platform text editor supporting Windows, Linux and macOS. Its core goal is to provide a domestic alternative for text editing software, with key adaptation for domestic trusted computing systems like UOS, offering users a clean editing tool free from inappropriate remarks.

metadata.name: HelloGitHub
metadata.description: :octocat: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目。Share interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub.

summary.zh: HelloGitHub是面向开源入门者的月刊项目，每月28日更新，精选GitHub上有趣、易上手的开源项目、书籍及实战案例，配套官网与公众号同步推送，降低开源探索门槛，帮助开发者快速感受开源魅力。
summary.en: HelloGitHub is a monthly open source curation project for beginners, updated on the 28th of each month. It selects interesting, easy-to-use open source projects, books and practical cases from GitHub, with synchronized updates on its official website and WeChat public account, lowering the barrier to open source exploration and helping developers quickly experience the charm of open source.

metadata.name: BPB-Worker-Panel
metadata.description: A GUI Panel providing Worker subscriptions for VLESS, Trojan and Warp configs alongside a private DoH server and chain proxies, offering full DNS, clean IP,  Fragment, Warp, Warp pro and routing settings for cross-platform clients using Amnezia, Wireguard, Sing-box, Clash/Mihomo and Xray cores.

summary.summary: 基于Cloudflare Workers部署的免费代理订阅面板，提供VLESS、Trojan、Warp配置及私有DoH服务，兼容Xray、Sing-box等多客户端核心，支持分片、链式代理、自定义路由规则，可解决网络封锁与污染问题，部署流程简单。
tags: 网络访问解锁与污染规避
tags_zh: 网络访问解锁与污染规避

metadata.name: NetMount
metadata.description: 统一管理和挂载云存储设施/Unified management and mounting of cloud storage facilities

summary.:: NetMount是基于Rust、TypeScript与Tauri框架开发的跨平台云存储统一管理工具，底层集成Rclone与OpenList能力，可集中挂载和管理各类云存储设施，解决多云存储分散访问痛点，支持桌面端使用，采用AGPL-3.0协议开源。
summary.en: NetMount is a cross-platform unified cloud storage management tool built with Rust, TypeScript and Tauri framework. It integrates capabilities of Rclone and OpenList to centrally mount and manage various cloud storage facilities, solving the pain point of fragmented multi-cloud access, supports desktop usage and is open-sourced under AGPL-3.0 license.

metadata.name: GoGoGo
metadata.description: 一个基于 Android 调试 API + 百度地图实现的虚拟定位工具，并且同时实现了一个可以自由移动的摇杆

summary.zh: 影梭是基于Android调试API与百度地图SDK开发的无需Root权限的安卓虚拟定位工具，支持定位修改、摇杆控制模拟移动、位置搜索等功能，兼容鸿蒙系统，采用GPLv3协议开源，仅可用于Android定位开发技术学习，禁止用于作弊等违规场景。
summary.en: Yingsuo (GoGoGo) is an Android mock location tool built on Android Debug API and Baidu Map SDK, requiring no root access. It supports location modification, joystick-controlled movement simulation, location search and more, works on HarmonyOS, and is open-sourced under GPLv3 license. It is exclusively for Android location development learning, and any cheating or misuse is prohibited.

metadata.name: iptv-api
metadata.description: ⚡️ IPTV直播源自动更新工具：自动采集、校验、测速并生成可播放结果，支持 M3U/TXT/API 输出、自定义频道、IPv4/IPv6、Docker、GitHub Actions、CLI 与 GUI 多端部署

summary.zh: IPTV直播源自动更新工具，全流程自动化完成直播源采集、多源聚合、可用性校验与测速筛选，支持自定义频道、IPv4/IPv6双栈，可输出M3U/TXT/API格式可用播放列表，支持CLI、GUI、Docker等多端部署，大幅降低直播源维护成本。
summary.en: Automated IPTV live source update tool that implements full-process automation for source collection, multi-source aggregation, availability verification, and speed testing. It supports custom channels, IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack, outputs playable playlists in M3U/TXT/API formats, and supports multi-deployment via CLI, GUI, and Docker, greatly reducing live source maintenance costs.

metadata.name: Cloudflare-vless-trojan
metadata.description: CF-workers/pages代理脚本：支持Vless-ws(tls)、Trojan-ws(tls)；Socks5/http本地代理脚本：可选ECH-TLS、普通TLS、无TLS三种代理模式

summary.zh: 本工具为Cloudflare Workers/Pages部署的代理脚本，支持VLESS/Trojan的ws+tls协议及本地Socks5/http代理，内置CF官方优选IP，无需第三方订阅，可生成多格式客户端订阅链接，支持自定义代理IP与分片抗墙，小白友好，解决节点被墙、订阅隐私泄露问题。
summary.en: This is a proxy script deployed on Cloudflare Workers/Pages, supporting VLESS/Trojan ws+tls protocols and local Socks5/http proxy. It comes with built-in CF official optimized IPs, requires no third-party subscriptions, supports multi-format client subscription links, custom proxy IPs and fragment-based anti-blocking, making it beginner-friendly and solving node blocking and subscription privacy leakage issues.

metadata.name: HotPEToolBox
metadata.description: 一个纯净、强大、优雅的WinPE

summary.:: 这是HotPE工具箱的构建工具仓库，基于Python开发，可将Win10/11原版系统镜像制作为功能完备的Win11PE，支持网络、远程、BitLocker磁盘解锁、U盘启动等丰富特性，兼容HotPE模块与Edgeless插件，适配Win11 22000.282及以下版本镜像，广泛用于系统故障排查、部署维护场景，采用MIT协议开源。
summary.en: This is the build tool repository of HotPE Toolbox, developed with Python. It converts original Windows 10/11 system images into fully functional Windows 11 PE, supporting features like network connectivity, remote access, BitLocker disk unlocking, and USB boot. It is compatible with HotPE modules and Edgeless plugins, works with Windows 11 builds up to 22000.282, and is widely used for system troubleshooting and deployment maintenance, under the MIT open source license.

metadata.name: taosync
metadata.description: TaoSync是一个适用于OpenList v3+的自动化同步工具/Sync for OpenList/AList

summary.zh: TaoSync是开源免费的跨平台自动化文件同步工具，兼容OpenList/AList v3+且内置存储引擎无需依赖外部实例，支持多云盘、FTP等存储间的全量/增量同步备份、定时下载，覆盖全主流操作系统与安卓，提供Docker部署方式。
summary.en: TaoSync is a free, open-source cross-platform automated file synchronization tool compatible with OpenList/AList v3+, featuring a built-in storage engine that removes the dependency on external OpenList instances. It supports full/incremental sync backup and scheduled downloads across cloud drives, FTP and other storage services, covers all mainstream operating systems and Android, and provides Docker deployment support.

metadata.name: cf-proxy-ex
metadata.description: Cloudflare超级代理，无服务器代理，Duckduckgo代理（可用AI聊天，包含GPT4o/Claude3），Github加速，支持解锁Libgen，在线代理。现已支持多平台部署。Cloudflare super proxy, setting up a free serverless proxy by using Cloudflare worker, support Duckduckgo / Libgen. Now you can deploy this project on different platforms.

summary.zh: Cloudflare Proxy EX 是基于 Cloudflare Worker 的无服务器在线代理工具，支持多平台部署，可实现 GitHub 加速、Libgen 解锁、DuckDuckGo 及 AI 聊天服务代理访问，内置密码安全防护，适用于学习代理原理、合规访问受限网络资源。
summary.en: Cloudflare Proxy EX is a serverless online proxy built on Cloudflare Worker, supporting multi-platform deployment. It provides GitHub acceleration, Libgen unlocking, and proxied access to DuckDuckGo and AI chat services like GPT-4o/Claude 3, with built-in password protection, for learning proxy principles and compliantly accessing restricted resources.

metadata.name: NoMoreWalls
metadata.description: 自动抓取合并互联网上的公开节点。

summary.zh: NoMoreWalls自动抓取合并互联网公开代理节点，生成适配Clash Meta等工具的订阅配置，内置定制化分流规则，提供多CDN镜像防失联，采用反996许可证，适用于网络代理访问场景。
summary.en: NoMoreWalls automatically crawls and merges public proxy nodes from the internet, generates subscription configurations compatible with tools like Clash Meta, includes customized routing rules, offers multi-CDN mirrors to avoid service disconnection, and adopts the Anti-996 License for network proxy access scenarios.

metadata.name: httpsok
metadata.description: 🔥🔥🔥一行命令，轻松搞定SSL证书自动续期。 SSL泛域名证书，SSL证书管理，SSL证书自动续期，SSL证书自动更新，七牛云、阿里云、腾讯云、CDN、OSS、https证书管理,https证书管理,免费SSL证书,TLS证书自动续签,nginx证书自动续期工具，nginx证书管理。从此告别Let's Encrypt

metadata.name: Nagram
metadata.description: The third-party Telegram android app.

summary.zh: Nagram是基于NekoX二次开发的第三方Telegram安卓开源客户端，内置多协议代理、自定义表情包、多语言翻译、消息撤回重做等增强功能，支持隐私保护与个性化配置，满足用户高效便捷、安全稳定使用Telegram的需求。
summary.en: Nagram is an open-source third-party Telegram Android client forked from NekoX, featuring built-in multi-protocol proxy support, custom emoji packs, multi-language translation, message undo/redo and other enhanced functions, supporting privacy protection and personalized configuration to meet users' needs for efficient, convenient and stable Telegram usage.

metadata.name: awesome-cloudflare
metadata.description: ⛅️ 精选的 Cloudflare 工具、开源项目、指南、博客和其他资源列表。/ ⛅️ A curated list of Cloudflare tools, open source projects, guides, blogs and other resources.

summary.zh: 本仓库是面向独立开发者的 Cloudflare 生态开源资源精选列表，收录图床、对象存储、短链、网站分析等场景的轻量工具、指南与教程，聚焦开发提效与成本降低，提供多语言版本及在线导航，助力开发者快速搭建低成本互联网服务。
summary.en: This repository is a curated list of open-source resources for the Cloudflare ecosystem, tailored for indie developers. It collects lightweight tools, guides and tutorials for scenarios including image hosting, object storage, short links and web analytics, focusing on improving development efficiency and reducing costs, with multi-language versions and an online navigation to help developers build low-cost internet services quickly.

metadata.name: tvbox
metadata.description: OK影视、tvbox配置文件，如果喜欢，请Fork自用。使用前请仔细阅读仓库说明，一旦使用将被视为你已了解。

summary.zh: 本仓库为TVBox、OK影视及猫影视的聚合配置集合，整合多路大神分享的直播、点播资源接口，适配多款主流电视盒子与影视应用，提供网盘授权配置方案，支持用户Fork自用，适用于个人影音场景的测试学习。
summary.en: This repository is an aggregated configuration collection for TVBox, OK Video and Cat Video, integrating a large number of live streaming and on-demand resource interfaces shared by various domestic experts. It is fully adapted to mainstream TV boxes and mobile video applications, provides complete cloud disk authorization and danmu configuration solutions, and supports users to fork for personal use in audio-visual testing and learning scenarios. The repository includes multiple sets of configuration files for different usage scenarios, covering both minimalist and all-in-one resource collocation, which can meet the needs of different users for home TV and mobile terminal viewing.

metadata.name: Sandboxie
metadata.description: Sandboxie Plus & Classic

summary.zh: Sandboxie是Windows NT系系统开源社区维护的沙箱隔离工具，提供Plus、Classic双版本，核心能力是创建隔离虚拟环境运行或测试不受信程序、开展安全上网，避免永久修改主机系统、注册表与磁盘，支持多沙箱并行、快照管理等功能，适用于程序测试、系统安全防护场景。

metadata.name: ecs
metadata.description: VPS 融合怪服务器测评脚本 —— 更推荐使用无环境依赖的 Go 版本：https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs VPS Fusion Monster Server Test Script — we now recommend the Go version (zero external dependencies): https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs

summary.:: zh
summary.en: This is a multi-system, multi-architecture compatible VPS server comprehensive testing Shell script that supports both interactive and non-interactive parameter modes. It can perform full-dimensional tests covering performance testing, return route tracing, and IP quality detection, runs without root privileges, and comes with a one-click system bug fix tool, suitable for cloud server selection and network quality verification scenarios.

metadata.name: proxypin
metadata.description: Open source free capture HTTP(S) traffic  software ProxyPin, supporting full platform systems

summary.zh: ProxyPin是开源免费的跨平台HTTP(S)流量抓包工具，支持Windows、Mac、Android、iOS、Linux全系统，可拦截、调试、重写网络流量，支持扫码快速连接、JS脚本处理、请求重写/阻断、HAR格式导出等功能，基于Flutter开发界面友好，适用于移动应用与Web服务的网络调试场景。
summary.en: ProxyPin is an open-source, free cross-platform HTTP(S) traffic capture tool supporting full systems including Windows, Mac, Android, iOS and Linux. It enables traffic interception, inspection and rewriting, with features like QR code quick connection, JavaScript script processing, request rewriting/blocking, and HAR format export. Built with Flutter, it has a user-friendly UI, suitable for network debugging of mobile apps and web services.

metadata.name: GOODBYEADS
metadata.description: 适用于AdGuard、Quantumult X、SmartDNS的去广告规则，合并优质上游规则并去重整理排列。

metadata.name: FreeNodes
metadata.description: v2ray、clash免费节点爬虫，自动更新

summary.zh: 本仓库为AI驱动的v2ray/Clash免费代理节点自动爬虫项目，每日定时从多个公开节点站点抓取有效可用节点，生成标准格式订阅链接并提供镜像加速，仅供学习交流使用。
summary.en: This repository is an AI-driven automated crawler for free V2Ray/Clash proxy nodes, which runs daily to fetch valid nodes from multiple public sites, generates standard subscription links with mirror acceleration, and is for learning and communication only.

metadata.name: N3RD
metadata.description: CTV

summary.zh: N3RD（简称CTV）是轻量级计算机视觉工具集，封装常用CV算法与图像处理能力，支持快速集成到各类视觉开发项目，大幅降低计算机视觉开发门槛，适用于图像识别、视觉预处理等场景，具备跨平台、低依赖的技术优势。
summary.en: N3RD (abbreviated as CTV) is a lightweight computer vision toolkit that encapsulates common CV algorithms and image processing capabilities, supports rapid integration into various vision development projects, greatly lowers the threshold of computer vision development, applies to scenarios such as image recognition and visual preprocessing, and features cross-platform and low-dependency technical advantages.

metadata.name: adblockfilters
metadata.description: 去广告合并规则，每8个小时更新一次。

summary.:: zh": "该项目自动聚合多源广告过滤规则，每8小时定时更新，通过合并去重、DNS实时校验剔除无效域名，输出适配AdGuard、DNSMasq等多工具的轻量/完整规则库，解决多设备手动同步广告规则的痛点。",

metadata.name: TikTokDownloader
metadata.description: 抖音 / TikTok 平台作品下载/数据采集工具

summary.zh: DouK-Downloader 是基于 Python 开发的抖音/TikTok 一站式内容下载与数据采集工具，支持高清作品下载、全维度数据采集、WebUI 交互、批量处理及 Docker 部署，可满足内容备份、平台数据分析等场景需求，功能覆盖作品、直播、搜索等多维度采集能力。
summary.en: DouK-Downloader is a Python-based one-stop content download and data collection tool for Douyin/TikTok platforms. It supports high-definition media download, full-dimension data acquisition, WebUI interaction, batch processing and Docker deployment, meeting needs of content backup and platform data analysis, with capabilities covering works, live streams, search and other dimensions.
tags_zh: 短视频内容下载与数据采集
tags_en: Short Video Content Download & Data Collection

metadata.name: x-ui-yg
metadata.description: x-ui精简修改版脚本，支持Hysteria2、Xhttp传输协议、ENC加密、MLDSA65加密，集成argo固定临时双隧道（可共存）、Psiphon赛风VPN（30个国家）分流功能，支持部分节点聚合订阅、sing-box订阅、clash-meta订阅的配置输出

summary.zh: x-ui精简修改版一键部署脚本，面向代理服务搭建场景，支持Hysteria2、Xhttp等多传输协议及多种加密方式，集成Argo固定/临时双隧道、Psiphon 30国VPN分流能力，本地生成多格式订阅无需第三方外链，支持多架构、多系统及Docker部署，保障订阅隐私。
summary.en: A simplified modified one-click deployment script for x-ui proxy panel, targeting proxy service construction scenarios. It supports transport protocols including Hysteria2 and Xhttp, multiple encryption schemes, integrates co-existent fixed/temporary Argo tunnels and Psiphon VPN with 30-country traffic splitting, generates multi-format subscriptions locally without third-party links, and supports multi-architecture, multi-OS and Docker deployment, ensuring subscription privacy.

metadata.name: lx-music-sync-server
metadata.description: 运行在 Node.js 上的 LX Music 数据同步服务

summary.zh: 本项目是LX Music的独立数据同步服务端，基于Node.js开发，用于解决音乐收藏列表等多端数据同步需求，可部署至服务器，支持Nginx反向代理实现HTTPS加密、PM2进程守护及数据快照恢复，适合自建私有音乐数据同步服务的场景。
summary.en: This is an independent data sync server for LX Music, built with Node.js, designed to synchronize music favorites and other data across multiple devices. It can be deployed on servers, supports Nginx reverse proxy for HTTPS encryption, PM2 process management, and data snapshot recovery, suitable for building private music data sync services.

metadata.name: 1Panel
metadata.description: 🔥 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel and a lightweight AI management platform.

summary.summary: 1Panel是开源Linux服务器管理面板与轻量AI管理平台，通过可视化Web界面提供主机监控、文件/数据库/容器管理、网站一键部署等一站式运维能力，集成AI网关与Agent统一管理，内置开源应用商店，服务全球250万+自托管用户。

metadata.name: biliup
metadata.description: 自动直播录制、投稿、twitch、ytb频道搬运工具。命令行投稿(B站)和视频下载工具，提供多种登录方式，支持多p。边录边传0落盘

summary.zh: biliup是开源直播录制、跨平台搬运与B站投稿自动化工具，支持19个主流直播平台（含Twitch、YouTube）录制与弹幕抓取，具备边录边传0落盘、WebUI实时监控、多主播24小时无人值守能力，可集成AI Agent实现UP主运营自动化，支持命令行与可视化双模式，兼容多账号多P视频处理。
summary.en: biliup is an open-source live stream recording, cross-platform content migration and Bilibili upload automation tool. It supports recording and danmaku capture for 19 mainstream live platforms including Twitch and YouTube, features zero-disk recording while uploading, WebUI real-time monitoring, 24/7 unattended multi-streamer operation, and can be integrated with AI Agents for automated creator operation, supporting both CLI and visual modes with multi-account and multi-part video compatibility.

metadata.name: mediago
metadata.description: Cross-platform video downloader — sniff and grab m3u8/HLS streams, Bilibili, YouTube and more. Desktop + Docker + 🦞.

summary.zh: MediaGo是跨平台视频下载工具，内置流量嗅探能力，可直接抓取m3u8/HLS流及B站、YouTube等1000+站点视频资源，支持桌面端、Docker部署，配套浏览器插件、AI助手集成、HTTP API与内置格式转换，无需抓包或配置浏览器扩展即可快速完成下载。
summary.en: MediaGo is a cross-platform video downloader with built-in traffic sniffing, capable of directly capturing m3u8/HLS streams and videos from 1000+ sites including Bilibili and YouTube. It supports desktop and Docker deployment, and provides browser extension, AI assistant integration, HTTP API and built-in format conversion, enabling fast video download without packet capture or browser extension configuration.

metadata.name: anti-AD
metadata.description: 致力于成为中文区命中率最高的广告过滤列表，实现精确的广告屏蔽和隐私保护。anti-AD 现已支持 AdGuardHome，dnsmasq，Surge，Pi-Hole，Clash, mihomo，smartdns，sing-box 等网络组件。完全兼容常见的广告过滤工具所支持的各种广告过滤列表格式

summary.zh: anti-AD是面向中文区的高命中率广告过滤列表项目，通过域名解析层实现广告屏蔽与隐私保护，支持AdGuardHome、Pi-Hole、Clash、Surge等十余种主流网络组件，兼容各类广告过滤列表格式，可屏蔽广告域名、App内置广告及隐私收集站点。
summary.en: anti-AD is a high-hit-rate ad-blocking list project designed for Chinese users, which realizes ad blocking and privacy protection via DNS resolution layer. It supports over 10 mainstream network components such as AdGuardHome, Pi-Hole, Clash and Surge, is compatible with various ad-filtering list formats, and can block ad domains, in-app ads and privacy-tracking sites.

summary.zh: downkyi（哔哩哔哩下载姬）是一款B站视频下载工具，支持获取高清视频、弹幕字幕等全量资源，因涉及逆向分析平台接口、绕过付费内容保护与访问控制，被B站委托律所发律师函警告，现已停止维护并永久关停。
summary.en: downkyi, also known as Bilibili Downloader, is a tool designed to download Bilibili videos, supporting the acquisition of full resources such as high-definition videos, bullet comments and subtitles. It received a lawyer's warning letter from Bilibili for reverse-engineering the platform's non-public interfaces and bypassing paid content protection mechanisms, and has been permanently closed with all maintenance ceased.

metadata.name: SmartTube
metadata.description: Browse media content with your own rules on Android TV

summary.zh: SmartTube是一款开源免费的安卓电视/电视盒子媒体客户端，无需谷歌服务即可使用，支持8K/HDR/60fps播放、SponsorBlock去广告、自定义交互功能，可浏览播放公开平台媒体内容，适配Android 4.3及以上设备，暂不支持手机、平板等移动端。
summary.en: SmartTube is a free, open-source media client designed for Android TVs and TV boxes, with no dependency on Google Services. It supports 8K/HDR/60fps playback, SponsorBlock ad-skipping, and customizable controls, allowing users to browse and play public media content. It is compatible with Android 4.3 and above, but not for mobile devices.

metadata.name: changedetection.io
metadata.description: Best and simplest tool for website change detection, web page monitoring, and website change alerts. Perfect for tracking content changes, price drops, restock alerts, and website defacement monitoring—all for free or enjoy our SaaS plan!

summary.zh: changedetection.io 是一款开源网站变更检测工具，支持网页内容实时监控，可应用于价格变动追踪、商品补货提醒、网页篡改监测等场景；支持多平台通知推送，集成AI大模型实现智能告警过滤与自然语言变更摘要，提供自托管与SaaS双服务模式。
summary.en: changedetection.io is an open-source website change detection tool that supports real-time web page content monitoring, applicable to scenarios like price tracking, product restock alerts, and website defacement monitoring. It supports multi-platform notifications, integrates LLMs for intelligent alert filtering and natural language change summaries, and offers both self-hosted and SaaS service options.

metadata.description: 收集免费的接口服务,做一个api的搬运工

summary.:: 该仓库为免费API接口聚合项目，每月定期更新覆盖工具、生活、AI、数据查询等多类公开免费接口，为开发者和个人制作者提供便捷的接口调用资源，配套公众号同步推送更新与密钥，显著降低开发与测试成本。
summary.en: This repository is a free API aggregation project that updates public free APIs covering tools, daily life, AI, data query and other categories on a monthly basis, providing developers and individual makers with convenient API calling resources for small and medium-sized projects and personal development needs. It is accompanied by an official account to synchronize updates and keys, significantly reducing development and testing costs.

summary.summary: RSSPush是开源的RSS变动监测Web工具，可自动抓取RSS源更新并推送至微信、Telegram、Discord等数十种消息通道，支持Docker一键部署、内置RSSHub海量订阅源、关键词过滤与内容自动翻译，适用于个人内容聚合通知、团队信息同步等场景。

It is compatible with mainstream download tools like Aria2 and qBittorrent, with multiple CDN mirror addresses provided, serving as a practical configuration resource for BT users.

metadata.name: WebMonitor
metadata.description: 实时监控网页变化，并发送通知（Monitor web page changes in real time and send notifications）

summary.zh: WebMonitor是一款开源网页变更实时监控工具，支持requests/PhantomJS抓取网页，兼容XPath、CSS选择器及JsonPath数据提取，提供邮件、Telegram、微信等多渠道通知，具备可视化操作界面、监控规则配置、RSS更新监测等功能，适用于信息变更提醒、舆情监控等场景。
summary.en: WebMonitor is an open-source real-time web page change monitoring tool that supports web scraping via requests and PhantomJS, and is compatible with XPath, CSS selectors and JsonPath for data extraction. It offers multi-channel notifications including email, Telegram and WeChat, with features such as visual UI, monitoring rule configuration and RSS update tracking, suitable for information change alerts and public opinion monitoring.

summary.en: ContextMenuManager is a pure Windows context menu management desktop tool developed with .NET Framework, compatible with systems from Vista to Windows 10. It supports enabling/disabling, adding, deleting and modifying various context menu items, locating their registry and file paths, adapts to high-DPI screens, and is a completely free and open-source practical tool.

It also offers a VLESS protocol branch, suitable for low-cost stable proxy service setup.

metadata.name: ShareX
metadata.description: ShareX is a free and open-source application that enables users to capture or record any area of their screen with a single keystroke. It also supports uploading images, text, and various file types to a wide range of destinations.

summary.:: ShareX是免费开源的Windows桌面生产力工具，整合屏幕截图、录屏、文件分享与自动化工作流能力，无广告且无需账号，支持OCR文字识别、二维码扫描、自定义上传目的地，适用于开发者、内容创作者等群体高效完成捕获、编辑、分享全流程。
summary.en: ShareX is a free, open-source Windows desktop productivity tool that integrates screen capture, screen recording, file sharing and automated workflow capabilities. It is ad-free and requires no account, supporting OCR text recognition, QR code scanning and custom upload destinations, suitable for developers, content creators and other users to efficiently complete the full process of capture, editing and sharing.

metadata.name: v2rayN
metadata.description: A GUI client for Windows, Linux and macOS, support Xray and sing-box and others

summary.zh: v2rayN是开源跨平台桌面代理客户端，支持Xray、sing-box等主流代理核心，兼容Windows、Linux、macOS及多CPU架构，提供GPG签名校验保障下载安全，主要用于网络代理配置与跨境网络访问管理，是当前主流的桌面代理工具之一。
summary.en: v2rayN is an open-source cross-platform desktop proxy client supporting mainstream proxy cores such as Xray and sing-box, compatible with Windows, Linux, macOS and multiple CPU architectures. It offers GPG signature verification to ensure download security, mainly used for network proxy configuration and cross-border network access management, and is one of the mainstream desktop proxy tools.

metadata.name: ChromeAppHeroes
metadata.description: 🌈谷粒-Chrome插件英雄榜, 为优秀的Chrome插件写一本中文说明书, 让Chrome插件英雄们造福人类~  ChromePluginHeroes, Write a Chinese manual for the excellent Chrome plugin, let the Chrome plugin heroes benefit the human~ 公众号「0加1」同步更新

summary.zh: 《谷粒-Chrome插件英雄榜》是面向中文用户的Chrome插件精选指南项目，基于docsify构建并托管于GitHub Pages，完全开源，为上百款优质Chrome插件编写中文使用说明，覆盖翻译、去广告、视频工具、学习辅助等多类场景，降低优质插件的使用门槛，助力提升浏览器使用效率。
summary.en: ChromeAppHeroes is a Chinese-language Chrome extension curation and guide project, built with docsify and hosted on GitHub Pages as a fully open-source resource. It provides Chinese usage manuals for hundreds of high-quality Chrome extensions, covering scenarios like translation, ad blocking, video tools, and learning assistance, lowering the usage barrier of excellent extensions and helping improve browser usage efficiency.
